2608.24644.title: A Literate Programming Environment for Human and Machine Agents
2608.24644.paper_summary: This paper introduces an environment for constructing literate programs in concert with language-aware machine agents. This environment includes a grammar for executable program essays, a parser that treats names as first-class objects, an internal name-graph which relates prose, names and executable artifacts, and a binding mechanism for existing languages and testing toolsets. This supports co-location of code with its most relevant natural language and structured data context, making better use of Large Language Model (LLM) context windows. It also provides LLM coding agents with a toolset more analogous to the symbol-aware search and usage information available in human programmer-facing Integrated Development Environments (IDEs). We describe a working implementation with bindings to three established programming languages, and several example programs.
2608.24644.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹了一個環境，用於與具語言感知的機器代理協同構建有素養的程式。<lb/>這個環境包括一種可執行程式論文的語法、一個將名稱視為一級物件的解析器、一個將散文、名稱和可執行工件相關聯的內部名稱圖，以及一個與現有語言和測試工具集的綁定機制。<lb/>這支持程式碼與其最相關的自然語言和結構化數據上下文的共置，從而更好地利用大型語言模型（LLM）的上下文窗口。<lb/>它還為LLM編碼代理提供了一個工具集，更類似於人類程式設計師面向的整合開發環境（IDE）中可用的符號感知搜索和使用資訊。<lb/>我們描述了一個與三種成熟程式語言綁定的工作實現，以及幾個示例程式。
